faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DRDO DYSL QT Paid Intern posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the DRDO DYSL QT Paid Intern posts is 20th August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Paid Intern position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies for the Paid Intern position at DRDO Young Scientist Laboratory Quantum Technologies (DRDO DYSL QT).

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Paid Intern role?
faq.answer: The educational qualification includes pursuing the 7th/8th semester of B.Tech or 3rd/4th semester of M.Tech in relevant disciplines, or pursuing the IInd year of M.Sc Physics, preferably in Optics.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Paid Intern recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Paid Intern posts is 28 years. There is no minimum age limit specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Paid Intern position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Paid Intern position will receive a stipend of Rs. 5000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the DRDO DYSL QT Paid Intern recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves CGPA/Percentage based shortlisting, followed by an offline examination, telephonic interview, or in-person interaction, and finally document verification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q9. Where is DRDO DYSL QT located?
faq.answer: DRDO DYSL QT is located in Pune, Maharashtra, with the pincode 411025.

faq.question: Q10. When will the internship training start?
faq.answer: The internship training is scheduled to commence on 01st September 2026.
